Methods for Characterizing the Polymers (Especially the
Determination of Their Crystallinity) :
The degree of crystallinity of the crosslinked polymer

lines.text: may be determined after it has been crosslinked or molded.
In case the treated polymer is further irradiated, e.g., to
sterilize the polymer before its implant into humans, the
degree of crystallinity may be determined after
irradiation, since irradiation effects further
crystallization of the polymer.
The degree of crystallinity can be determined using
methods known in the art, e.g. by differential scanning
calorimetry (DSC), which is generally used to assess the
crystallinity and melting behavior of a polymer. Wang, X.
& Salovey, R., J. App. Polymer Sci., 34:. 593-599 (1987).
